title: Reading the induced tape at a block coordinate
statement: Let $N\in\mathbb{N}$, let $F$ assign to each integer a block of $N+1$ optional bits, and let $z\in\mathbb{Z}$ and $j\in\{0,\ldots,N\}$. The tape induced by $F$ has at position $(N+1)z+j$ exactly the entry at offset $j$ of the block $F(z)$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ assigns a block of $N+1$ optional bits to each integer
replaced:
Let $F$ assign to every integer a block of $N+1$ optional bits. The binary tape induced
by $F$ (position $p$ holding entry $p \bmod (N+1)$ of block
$F(\lfloor p/(N+1)\rfloor)$) reads, at position $(N+1)z + j$ with $z \in \mathbb{Z}$
and $j \in \{0,\dots,N\}$, exactly the entry $j$ of $F(z)$.
